title: Enterprise request rapid synthesis and heatmap for Sales handoff
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a lightweight, repeatable synthesis process and a visual heatmap artifact for Sales/CS to attach to enterprise feature requests. The goal is to reduce first-pass triage time from days to hours and produce a single-slide summary that captures value, risk, implementation appetite, and recommended next step. This ticket builds a template, an automated checklist, and a short-run pilot with two Sales pods.
background: A lot of high-touch enterprise asks come through Sales/CS as long prose threads or slide decks. PM and Eng spend time re-reading threads to identify impact, dependencies, and scope. We need a faster way to capture the signal and align on prioritization when capacity is limited. Existing artifacts in the intake repo are fragmented; this work synthesizes into one artifact and a simple heatmap that quantifies value vs. complexity for quick decisions.
proposal: Deliver a 1-page synthesis template (title, TL;DR, customer(s), use case, top 3 requirements, regulatory/security notes, suggested MVP scope, measurable success criteria, estimated level-of-effort buckets, and recommended next action). Produce a companion heatmap (value vs. implementation complexity) and a short scoring rubric for Sales/CS to fill out. Implement a checklist-based intake flow in the shared Drive and run a two-week pilot with Sales North America and CS Strategic.
success_metrics: ["Median first-pass triage time <= 48 hours for pilot requests", "Percentage of enterprise asks with a completed synthesis artifact >= 80% in pilot pods", "PM/Eng reported confidence >= 4/5 on initial scoping after artifact review"]
acceptance_criteria: - Template created and reviewed by at least 1 PM and 1 Eng. - Heatmap scoring rubric documented and examples filled for 10 historical asks. - Drive folder + template accessible to Sales/CS. - Pilot run planned and scheduled with two pods. - Feedback loop defined (form + weekly 30m sync) to iterate on template.
tasks:
1) Draft template and heatmap (PM)
2) Align rubric with Eng for complexity bands (Eng)
3) Populate examples from last 12 months (PM/CS)
4) Create Drive folder and editing rights (Ops)
5) Run pilot with two Sales pods for 2 weeks (PM/CS)
6) Collect feedback and revise template (PM)
7) Handoff to Sales enablement for broader rollout (PM)

decisions: - Keep template to one page to encourage completion. - Heatmap to use 3x3 grid with discrete buckets for complexity (Low/Med/High) and value (Low/Med/High). - Pilot limited to two pods to gather focused feedback before org-wide rollout.
open_questions:
- Will Legal need a mandatory section for regulated customers or should that be flagged as 'security note'?
- How strict should Sales be about requiring the artifact before PM review?
- Should we auto-create a Linear ticket when Sales uploads a completed template?
